kind: bootstrap workspace hint server contract review
conclusion: A non-null cacheWorkspace is suitable as a provisional initial live workspace hint for the same authenticated bootstrap user and unchanged selector. It is not an authorization capability or a guaranteed final selected workspace. Server ticket and reader authorization remain unchanged.

authorityChain.contract: desktopBootstrap first calls desktopSession; absent identity throws authRequired. authorizedCacheWorkspace receives that exact session.user.id and the optional requested workspace ID. The returned user and cacheWorkspace belong to the same bootstrap operation.
desktop.bootstrap uses the existing optional-workspace schema. Renderer also validates the workspace UUID before requesting it; no request value can select an unlisted membership.

Each invocation executes one actual SELECT of workspaces joined to memberships filtered by the authenticated userId and status='active'; only workspaceId and role are projected. An explicit unlisted workspace returns null. No disk-provided membership or cross-request memo is used here.
DesktopBootstrap includes cacheWorkspace as workspaceId plus admin/member role, or null; it contains no signed live capability.

The ordinary Native bootstrap identity may use Better Auth's existing signed token-bound read cache. The membership SELECT is current, but bootstrap must not be described as an unconditional fresh DB session lookup.

Ticket route independently validates allowed human bearer/cookie, requests getSession with disableCookieCache=true, validates workspace UUID, checks current active membership for authenticated userId, then signs both owner and workspace. Invalid/revoked identity is 401; missing/invalid workspace membership is 403. No gateway configuration produces null ticket fields.

Builtin gateway ticket carries bounded session ID plus signature/expiry; source explicitly requires fresh session validation at upgrade and open. A workspace hint cannot construct or authorize this ticket.

selectionRules.scenario: explicit valid requested workspace and active membership
selectionRules.finalWorkspace: explicit loadWorkspaceContext selection matches when the same selector is actually supplied
ordinary reader remains responsible for its access failure; do not fall back to an older hint
renderer deliberately nulls the cache hint even though it sent an unscoped bootstrap

selectionRules.scenario: no explicit requested workspace; valid selection cookie
selectionRules.finalWorkspace: loadWorkspaceContext uses that valid cookie too

selectionRules.scenario: no explicit requested workspace; missing or stale selection cookie
selectionRules.cacheWorkspace: earliest active membership by workspace creation time, or null
selectionRules.finalWorkspace: loadWorkspaceContext prefers a personal workspace before the first choice; it may create a missing personal workspace. Selection equality is not guaranteed.
bootstrap gate creates no workspace; later ordinary workspace reader may initialize one through its existing first-use path

selectionRules.scenario: membership removed or session revoked after bootstrap
selectionRules.finalWorkspace: fresh ticket and each ordinary read retain their existing refusal; cached hint does not extend authorization

selectionRules.scenario: client selector changes after the bootstrap
selectionRules.cacheWorkspace: old observation for the previous selector
selectionRules.finalWorkspace: must not seed another selector with this hint; AuthenticatedReadCache already disables persistence when requested workspace differs

clientBoundary.existingOwnerBinding: AuthenticatedReadCache receives user.id and bootstrap.cacheWorkspace from Workspace; any initial Live hint must retain the same-owner guard.
clientBoundary.existingSelectorGuard: AuthenticatedReadCache permits a workspace namespace only when there is no explicit requested selector or it exactly equals workspace.workspaceId.
clientBoundary.provisionalUse: Use a matching bootstrap hint only while the real workspace read is unresolved. A successfully resolved same-user workspace remains authoritative. A mismatched-user result, invalid selector, or unavailable/null bootstrap authority is not permission to borrow the old hint.
clientBoundary.unscopedReader: WorkspaceScope currently calls useWorkspace(user.email) without an explicit workspace argument. Therefore an explicit bootstrap URL selector alone does not prove the later unscoped API request chooses the same workspace.
clientBoundary.noAuthorizationChange: Do not skip/seed server auth, do not manufacture LiveRead revisions or home-scope proofs, do not replace ticket verification, and do not suppress a real later scope change.
clientBoundary.regressionOwnership: Root and native agent own the real React/SWR lifecycle reproduction; this report is static server contract review only.

limitations: This source analysis does not establish that the proposed hint eliminates the current 44-query regression.
A hint may be stale immediately after its current membership read; correctness relies on the unchanged fresh ticket/reader boundaries.
No actual request values, membership data, account identifiers or credentials were read.
